new.pageSubline: Name it and start tracking. Everything saves in this browser.

next.title: What happens next
next.one: An empty playthrough is saved in this browser at once.
next.two: It becomes the active playthrough if the box is ticked. The sidebar switcher shows it.
next.three: You land on the Playthroughs list with the new card on top and an Undo toast.

form.title: Create New Playthrough
form.help: Give your playthrough a memorable name to help you identify it later.
form.errorEmpty: Please enter a name for your playthrough
form.failed: Failed to create playthrough. Please try again.

edit.title: Edit playthrough
edit.help: Press Enter to save. Save stays off while the name is blank.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This removes all of its saved progress on this device.
delete.activeNext: This is your active playthrough. {next} is the most recently updated, so it becomes active after the delete.
delete.activeLast: This is your active playthrough and your only one. No playthrough is active after the delete.
